expected_invariant: Every full Git object ID in continuation evidence is read exactly from Git; a precommit receipt describes the commit as pending and never predicts its future object ID.
observed_error: The final-freeze precommit metadata and first uncommitted preexecution state expanded short prefix 1ccb739e with an invented suffix 721419bec2a41f717cd02aa8ed63250f. After commit, git rev-parse HEAD returned exact 1ccb739e91283606f93102b399bd43e30716e230.
detection_method: The preexecution five-source Git check compared the state claim with direct git rev-parse HEAD before any database runtime was opened.

correction.action: Preserve the committed precommit misreport, replace every live preexecution occurrence with direct git rev-parse output, regenerate the five-source receipt and commit the correction before runtime.
correction.prevention_control: Precommit evidence may name only the current exact HEAD and a pending commit; post-commit full hashes must be copied from direct Git output and mechanically compared before receipt admission.
